details: CONFIRMED by reading lib/relay_marks.show (bin/relay show_check falls to it for a branch): gate, mark, outside; no
finding summary. The judge base's reply carries the most important finding for this flow, so the front already has
the point without another runner read; naming it avoids an extra read per merge and a guessed line. The same gap holds
for "<n> inside the change" (show prints open/queued/outside, not the inside count), which predates this change.
LOW: the screen can still be made; the instruction is unclear, not wrong. Size: 5 minutes.
evidence: lib/relay_marks.py:291-301 builds only "gate ...", "mark ...: open %d, queued %d, reviewed %s", "outside: ...".
plugins/front/skills/front/SKILL.md:62-65 "Ask a runner for the numbers: `relay check show <branch>` prints three lines ...; the runner also names the main review point in plain words."
failing_case: The front follows the skill: it asks a runner for `relay check show wt/no-merge-page`. That prints three lines
("gate <sha>: exit 0", "mark <sha>: open 0, queued 0, reviewed <sha>", "outside: 2 in the review") and no finding text.
The skill then says "the runner also names the main review point in plain words" without saying from where, so the
runner must guess a command (or the front fills the line from memory). The line should come from a named source:
the critic's hand-back (it already gives "the one finding that matters most") or `relay check show <reviewed sha> --brief`.
fix_hint: Replace "the runner also names the main review point in plain words" with "the main review point is the critic's
hand-back line on the finding that matters most, in plain words".
pass_cases: - The merge section names one source for "Main review point": e.g. "the critic's hand-back line on the finding that matters most" (the front already holds it), or the runner command `relay check show <reviewed sha> --brief`.
- The section still says the front never reads the review, the check report or the gate log itself.
- The section still names `relay check show <branch>` for the three lines (tests/test_relay.py Roles test).
findings.summary: the screen asks for a main review point, but the named source cannot give it: `relay check show <branch>` prints no finding
